ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: An initiative by the Government of India that provides income support to landholder farmer families to purchase agricultural inputs and domestic needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to bank accounts.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: A crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to natural calamities, pests, & diseases.
benefits: Comprehensive insurance coverage against crop failure, with very low premium rates for farmers (1.5% to 5% depending on crop type).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Focuses on improving water use efficiency at the farm level through micro-irrigation technologies like drip and sprinkler systems.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, and 45% for other farmers for installing micro-irrigation systems.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers to secure their life post-retirement.
benefits: A assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining the age of 60 years.
required_documents: KCC (Kisan Credit Card) or land document

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Promotes soil test-based nutrient management. Gives farmers recommendations on dosage of nutrients and soil health improvement.
benefits: Free soil test and dynamic advice printed on a card describing nutrition level and recommended crop management steps.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Assists farmers in purchasing high-end agricultural machinery and modern equipment through farm hubs.
benefits: 40% to 50% financial assistance/subsidy for purchasing tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and harvesters.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / RBI
description: Provides farmers with timely credit for their cultivation needs, purchase of seeds, fertilizers, and pesticide requirements.
benefits: Low-interest loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 4% effective interest rate (with timely repayment subsidy). No collateral required for loans up to ₹1.6 Lakh.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Supports installation of solar pumps, grid connected solar power plants, and solarization of existing grid pumps.
benefits: Up to 60% subsidy for setting up standalone solar pumps (State + Central share) and additional 30% bank loan options.
required_documents: Declaration of availability of water source

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
description: Provides financial, technical, and business support for the upgrade and formalization of existing micro-food processing enterprises.
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: A medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: 3% interest subvention per annum on loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum period of 7 years, along with credit guarantee coverage.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Promotes organic farming through a cluster-based approach and PGS (Participatory Guarantee System) certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years, out of which ₹31,000 is given directly to the farmer for organic inputs.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Allows states to choose their own agriculture development activities based on local requirements, promoting holistic farming.
benefits: Grants and subsidies for setting up polyhouses, cold storages, mushroom farming units, and organic composting sites.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Promotes scientific beekeeping for the 'Sweet Revolution' to increase farmer income and crop pollination.
benefits: Subsidy of up to 50% of cost for bee hives, colonies, bee boxes, extraction equipment, and training.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Supports agriculture graduates in setting up private clinics and centers to provide advisory services to farmers.
benefits: 36% subsidy on capital cost of project (44% for women, SC/ST, and North East region) with loans up to ₹20 Lakh (individual) and ₹100 Lakh (group).
required_documents: Degree/Diploma in Agriculture or allied sciences

ministry: Department of Revenue, Government of Madhya Pradesh
description: State-level scheme to supplement the PM-KISAN scheme, providing extra financial support to farmers in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Additional ₹4,000 per year paid in two equal installments of ₹2,000 to PM-KISAN beneficiaries in MP.

scheme_name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM YASASVI)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: A scholarship program designed for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Top Class Schools.
benefits: School fee, hostel fee, and books reimbursement up to ₹75,000/year (class 9-10) and ₹1,25,000/year (class 11-12).

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students for pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses.
benefits: 100% tuition fee coverage, academic allowance up to ₹13,500 per year, and support for disabled students.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students for pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses.
benefits: Compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement and maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200 per month.

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year for Graduation (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per year for Post-Graduation.

scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Empowers girls by providing financial assistance to pursue technical education (Degree or Diploma courses).
benefits: ₹50,000 per year for a maximum of 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma students as tuition/equipment fee.

scheme_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Supports specially-abled students who wish to pursue technical education degree or diploma.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition fee and equipment/books support for the entire duration of technical courses.

ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Designed for improving the quality of research in various higher educational institutions in the country (IITs, IISc, IISERs, NITs, Central Universities).
benefits: Fellowship of ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 per month and a research grant of ₹2 Lakh per year for 5 years.
required_documents: Detailed PhD Proposal / Statement of Purpose

ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Aims to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop-out at class VIII.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) from class IX to class XII.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
ministry: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Supports post-graduate education of single girl children in non-professional courses.
benefits: ₹36,200 per year for a period of 2 years (duration of PG course) paid directly.
required_documents: Single Girl Child Affidavit on ₹50 Stamp Paper

scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST Candidates
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Facilitates low-income SC/ST candidates to obtain Master's degree or Ph.D. courses abroad.
benefits: Full tuition fee coverage, maintenance allowance of $15,400 per year, travel expenses, and health insurance.
required_documents: Offer letter from QS Top 500 Foreign University

ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Assistance to orphans, wards of parents died due to Covid-19, and wards of Armed Forces/Paramilitary killed in action to pursue technical study.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum as a lump sum amount for tuition fees, purchase of books, equipment, etc.
required_documents: Death Certificate of parents (Covid-19 / Martyr proof / Orphan Certificate)

ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
description: Attracts meritorious youth to study natural and basic sciences at BSc, BS, MSc levels.
benefits: ₹80,000 per year (₹60,000 scholarship + ₹20,000 mentorship/project cost) for natural science students.
required_documents: INSPIRE Advisory Note (from board showing top 1% rank in 12th)

ministry: Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB)
description: For brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from all over the world to take up scientific research in India.
benefits: Fellowship of ₹1,35,000 per month and a research grant of ₹7 Lakh per annum for 5 years.
required_documents: Curriculum Vitae (CV) with list of publications

ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Provides financial assistance to minority students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees in Indian Universities.
benefits: Fellowship equivalent to JRF/SRF (₹31,000 - ₹35,000 per month) along with contingency grants for research.

ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies for minority community students.
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course period + 1 year) on educational loans for overseas Master's/Ph.D.
required_documents: Education Loan Sanction Letter from Bank

ministry: Department of Higher Education, Madhya Pradesh
description: Financial aid for girl students residing in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh who achieve high marks in class XII.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹5,000 per academic year (₹500 per month for 10 months) for pursuing higher education degree.

ministry: Department of Higher Education, Madhya Pradesh
description: Provides financial support to meritorious girl students living in urban BPL families in Madhya Pradesh to pursue higher education.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹4,000 per academic year for Degree courses and ₹3,000 for technical courses.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
description: Financial help for OBC students of Madhya Pradesh studying in post-matric courses.
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition fees and maintenance allowance up to ₹750 per month based on the course.

ministry: Department of Higher Education, Madhya Pradesh
description: Covers high higher education costs (Engineering, Medical, Law, PG) for meritorious students of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Full fee reimbursement (except caution money) for students securing admission in IITs, NITs, NLU, government colleges, or private medical colleges.
required_documents: Marksheet of Class XII (min 70% in MP Board or 85% in CBSE)

ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
description: Financial support to General, OBC, SC, ST, and Minority students in UP for studying in class 11, 12, or higher courses.
benefits: Reimbursement of non-refundable fees and a monthly allowance of up to ₹1,200 depending on the course standard.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Finance
description: A small deposit scheme for girl child launched under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign. Aims to meet education and marriage costs.
benefits: High interest rate (currently 8.2%), tax deductions under 80C, and maturity amount with tax exemption when the girl turns 21.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A maternity benefit program offering cash incentives for pregnant and lactating mothers for the first living child.
benefits: Direct Cash transfer of ₹5,000 in three installments to compensate for wage loss and promote nutrition intake.
required_documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card details

scheme_name: Free Sewing Machine Scheme (Nishulka Silai Machine Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Assists poor and labor class women with sewing machines to start self-employment from home.
benefits: Free mechanical sewing machine or equivalent cash subsidy to buy a high-quality machine.

ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh
description: Enhances the economic independence of women, improves their health/nutrition status, and strengthens their decision-making power.
benefits: Direct cash transfer of ₹1,250 per month (₹15,000 per year) directly to bank accounts of married women.

ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh
description: Improves the educational and economic status of girls and changes the negative attitude towards the birth of a girl child.
benefits: National Savings Certificates purchased for the girl. Assured milestones payouts: ₹30,000 for college admission, and overall lump sum of ₹1.43 Lakh on completion of 21 years.

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Empowers women members of Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to earn a sustainable income of at least ₹1 Lakh per year.
benefits: Skill training (LED bulb making, drone operation, agriculture, tailoring), financial assistance, and access to interest-free loans for entrepreneurship.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Provides integrated support and assistance under one roof to women affected by violence, both in private and public spaces.
benefits: Emergency medical aid, police assistance, psycho-social counseling, legal aid, and temporary shelter up to 5 days for free.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: A women-centric self-employment program in the coir industry, providing training and distribution of coir processing machinery.
benefits: 75% subsidy on the cost of motorized ratts/machinery and a stipend of ₹3,000 during the two-month training period.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Provides safe and affordable accommodation for working women, along with daycare facilities for their children, in urban areas.
benefits: Highly subsidized hostel accommodation in safe areas, daycare facilities for children up to 8 years, and standard security.
required_documents: Relationship proof with children (if using daycare)

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Rehabilitates women in difficult circumstances (widows deserted without support, survivors of disasters, trafficked women).
benefits: Free food, clothing, shelter, medical care, and vocational training for social rehabilitation.
required_documents: None (Referral from district magistrate or police is accepted directly)

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
description: Micro-finance scheme to provide loans to women entrepreneurs belonging to backward classes to start small retail ventures.
benefits: Microloans up to ₹1,40,000 at a very low interest rate of 4% per annum.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women Entrepreneurs
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Promotes entrepreneurship at the grassroots level, focusing specifically on greenfield enterprises set up by women.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore covering up to 75% of the project cost for starting a new factory or business.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: A safe motherhood intervention scheme promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women to reduce maternal mortality.
benefits: Cash assistance of up to ₹1,400 for mothers in rural areas and ₹1,000 in urban areas upon delivery in a government hospital.

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
description: Provides conditional cash transfers to girls of Uttar Pradesh from birth up to graduation to support health & education.
benefits: ₹15,000 paid in 6 stages (Birth, Vaccination, Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, and Admission to Degree/Diploma).

ministry: Rural Livelihood Mission, Madhya Pradesh
description: Provides vehicle services to rural women for safe institutional delivery and other emergency hospital visits.
benefits: Free emergency transport vehicle service managed by women Self Help Groups in rural tribal areas.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / LIC
description: A pension scheme exclusively for senior citizens that offers guaranteed interest payouts for financial security.
benefits: Guaranteed rate of return of 7.4% per annum paid monthly/quarterly/yearly for 10 years, with loan facility up to 75% of purchase price.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Financial assistance to senior citizens belonging to below poverty line (BPL) households.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 (age 60-79) and ₹500 per month (age 80 and above). States usually match this amount.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides physical aids and assisted living devices to senior citizens belonging to BPL categories who suffer from age-related disabilities.
benefits: Free high-quality assistive devices like walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, hearing aids, wheelchairs, spectacles, and artificial dentures.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: A pension scheme focused on the unorganized sector workers, allowing them to save for their retirement.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 after the age of 60 based on contributions.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account with auto-debit consent

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: A government-backed savings program offering high security and regular interest income to seniors.
benefits: High interest rate of 8.2% per annum, quarterly interest payouts, and tax benefits up to ₹1.5 Lakh under Section 80C.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / LIC
description: A social security scheme for senior citizens to shield them against a future drop in interest income.
benefits: Guaranteed rate of return of 8% per annum for a period of 10 years paid in the form of immediate annuity.

ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: A pension scheme for unorganized workers like street vendors, rickshaw pullers, domestic workers, etc.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining the age of 60 years.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Laghu Vyapari Maan-dhan Yojana (PM-LVMY)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: A pension scheme for self-employed shopkeepers, retail traders, and small businessmen with annual turnover not exceeding ₹1.5 Crore.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching 60 years of age.

scheme_name: National Pension System (NPS) - All Citizen Model
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: A voluntary defined contribution pension system designed to enable systematic savings during working life.
benefits: Tax savings up to ₹2 Lakh, flexible investment choices (equity, corporate bonds, government securities), and regular pension post-retirement.

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: A social security umbrella containing pension schemes for senior citizens, widows, and disabled persons.
benefits: Direct financial aid ranging from ₹200 to ₹1,000 per month depending on beneficiary type.

scheme_name: Elderline - National Helpline for Senior Citizens (14567)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: A toll-free helpline providing information, guidance, emotional support, and rescue services for elders.
benefits: Free toll-free assistance for abuse prevention, health guidance, legal info, and shelter rescue support.

ministry: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, MP
description: Pension for destitute senior citizens of Madhya Pradesh who do not qualify for other central schemes.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹600 directly transferred to bank accounts.

scheme_name: Varistha Mediclaim Policy for Senior Citizens
ministry: National Insurance Company
description: A government-backed health insurance policy explicitly designed to cater to the medical needs of elderly people.
benefits: Health cover up to ₹2 Lakh for hospitalization and ₹10,000 for critical illness with tax benefits on premium.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Utilizes unclaimed money in PPF, EPF, and small savings schemes to fund welfare programs for senior citizens.
benefits: Funds are used to provide health care schemes, old age homes, nutrition centers, and safety equipment in communities.
required_documents: Application of need to local social welfare officer

ministry: Ministry of Culture
description: Financial support to veteran artists who have contributed significantly in their field but are in indigent circumstances.
benefits: Monthly pension of up to ₹6,000 to artists after reaching the age of 60.
required_documents: Evidence of contribution to art (awards, brochures, news clippings)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) - Shishu Loan
ministry: Ministry of Finance / SIDBI
description: Provides loans to micro-enterprises and startups to start business activities with zero collateral.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹50,000 with nominal processing fees and flexible repayment schedules.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) - Kishor & Tarun Loans
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Funding for established small businesses looking to expand their operations.
benefits: Loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh (Kishor) and ₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh (Tarun) without collateral.

ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
description: Provides financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry.
benefits: Grants up to ₹20 Lakh for validation of proof of concept/prototype, and up to ₹50 Lakh via debt/convertible debentures for market entry.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises.
benefits: Subsidy of 15% to 35% on project costs up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service sectors. Rest funded by banks.
required_documents: Education Certificate (8th pass minimum for projects >₹10L)

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Facilitates bank loans for starting greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors.
benefits: Loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up new businesses, covering up to 75% of the project cost.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of MSME / SIDBI
description: Provides credit guarantees to financial institutions to facilitate collateral-free loans for MSMEs.
benefits: Collateral-free credit up to ₹5 Crore (guarantee cover up to 85% of the loan amount provided by CGTMSE).

scheme_name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship)
ministry: Ministry of MSME
description: Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) and Technology Business Incubators (TBI) to foster rural entrepreneurship.
benefits: Financial support up to ₹1 Crore for setting up government incubators, and up to ₹4 Lakh per startup as incubation grants.

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: Accelerates software product startups in India with funding, mentorship, and international scale support.
benefits: Co-investment matching funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup, plus access to top accelerators and demo days.

scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: A first-of-its-kind venture fund in India to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes who want to scale technology businesses.
benefits: Concessional finance up to ₹15 Crore (equity/debt funding) at low interest rates.
required_documents: SC Caste Certificate of promoters (must hold at least 51% stake)

ministry: Ministry of MSME
description: Facilitates technology up-gradation of micro and small enterprises in specified sub-sectors.
benefits: 15% capital subsidy (up to ₹15 Lakh) on institutional finance availed for induction of well-established technologies.

ministry: Ministry of MSME
description: Encourages and supports creative ideas and innovative mindsets in the MSME sector.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹15 Lakh per approved idea to develop prototype, and support for commercialization.

ministry: Department of MSME, Madhya Pradesh
description: Assists young citizens of Madhya Pradesh in setting up self-employment ventures by providing interest subsidies on loans.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹10 Lakh (service). 3% per annum interest subsidy and full credit guarantee fees paid by state government.

ministry: Department of MSME, Madhya Pradesh
description: Provides financial assistance for setting up new industries or service businesses in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: 15% to 30% margin money subsidy on loans up to ₹50,000 to ₹10 Lakh depending on category.

scheme_name: ODOP (One District One Product) Margin Money Scheme (UP)
ministry: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh
description: Financial assistance for setting up micro-units related to district-specific products in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Margin money subsidy of up to 25% of project cost (max ₹20 Lakh) on business loans for ODOP manufacturing.
required_documents: Project Report of ODOP product unit

ministry: SIDBI
description: Refinancing facility to banks extending credit under Stand-Up India to keep loan rates low.
benefits: Enables banks to offer Stand-up loans at the lowest possible base rates (MCLR + 3% maximum).
required_documents: Sanction Letter of Standup India Loan

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Skill certification scheme aiming to enable a large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
benefits: Free skill training, assessment, and certification in tech, agriculture, manufacturing. Includes soft skills training and job placement placement assistance.

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Promotes apprenticeship training and increases engagement of apprentices in industries.
benefits: Sharing of 25% of prescribed stipend subject to a max of ₹1,500 per month per apprentice, paid directly to candidates during training.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides free skill training programs for SC, OBC, EBC, and Safai Karamcharis to enhance their employment capacity.
benefits: Free skill training (Short term, Up-skilling, Entrepreneurship) with a stipend of up to ₹1,500 per month and full job placement assistance.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: A rural youth placement-linked skill training program to diversify income of rural poor families.
benefits: Free residential/non-residential skill training, free books, uniform, tablet, and guaranteed placement in companies with standard wages.

ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: A digital portal connecting job seekers with employers, offering counseling, vocational guidance, and job fair info.
benefits: Free job search, free career assessment tests, details of job fairs, and direct application to private & government vacancies.

ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment / EPFO
description: Incentivizes employers for creation of new employment and social security benefits during Covid recovery.
benefits: Government pays both employee (12%) and employer (12%) share of EPF contribution (total 24%) for 2 years for new employees earning <₹15,000/month.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked with UAN (Universal Account Number)

ministry: Department of Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment, MP
description: On-the-job training scheme for youth of Madhya Pradesh. Connects them to companies where they can learn skills and earn.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹8,000 (12th pass), ₹8,500 (ITI pass), ₹9,000 (Diploma pass), and ₹10,000 (Graduate/PG pass) during training.

ministry: Madhya Pradesh Rojgar Nirman Board
description: Official employment exchange portal in Madhya Pradesh to link job seekers with local corporate jobs and job fairs.
benefits: Free job alerts, access to government job notifications in MP, free training camp info, and job fair registration.

ministry: Sewa Yojana Department, Uttar Pradesh
description: Digital platform of UP Government connecting unemployed youth to job vacancies, skills, and private jobs.
benefits: Unemployment allowance of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 per month for registered unemployed graduates (varies with budget), plus job fair listings.

ministry: Ministry of MSME
description: Provides support to artisans and craftspeople (carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, weavers) working with hands/tools.
benefits: Skill upgrading training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit digital voucher, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The largest health assurance scheme in the world, providing cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalization.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in empaneled hospitals.

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all homeless householders and those living in dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.2 Lakh (plain areas) and ₹1.3 Lakh (hilly areas) for building houses, plus toilet construction assistance.

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Addresses urban housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories, including slum dwellers, by ensuring a pucca house.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans up to ₹6 Lakh for EWS, and direct grants of ₹1.5 Lakh for house construction.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Food security welfare scheme providing free food grains to the poorest citizens through Public Distribution System (PDS).
benefits: 5 kg of foodgrains (wheat or rice) per person per month absolutely free of cost to all NFSA (National Food Security Act) beneficiaries.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked with ration card

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides clean cooking fuel (LPG connections) to women from BPL households to replace unhealthy wood stoves.
benefits: Free LPG connection (including stove, cylinder, regulator) with an ongoing subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder refills (up to 12 refills/year).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: A micro-credit scheme to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods post-pandemic.
benefits: First loan up to ₹10,000 interest-subsidized (7% rebate). Upon timely repayment, eligibility for second loan up to ₹20,000 and third loan up to ₹50,000.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Vendor ID Card

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Aims to reduce rural poverty by promoting self-employment and organization of rural poor women into Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
benefits: Revolving fund of ₹15,000 and Community Investment Fund (CIF) of ₹1.10 Lakh per SHG to start small production and micro-enterprise units.

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services, namely Savings Bank accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, pension.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, free RuPay debit card with ₹2 Lakh accident insurance cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 for families.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (or Voter ID / Driving License / NREGA card)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: A one-year life insurance scheme, renewable from year to year, offering life insurance cover for death due to any reason.
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh on death of the insured due to any reason, at a very low premium of ₹436 per annum.
required_documents: Consent form for auto-debit from savings bank account

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: An accident insurance scheme offering protection against death or disability due to an accident.
benefits: Accidental death and full disability cover of ₹2 Lakh, and partial disability cover of ₹1 Lakh, at a premium of ₹20 per annum.
required_documents: Consent for bank auto-debit of premium

scheme_name: Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) - Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) Grant
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Ministry of Housing & Urban
description: Provides financial aid to rural and urban families to construct individual household toilets to end open defecation.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹12,000 to eligible households for constructing an individual sanitary toilet.
required_documents: Photograph of the site/house before construction

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Subsidized health insurance policy for unorganized sector workers and BPL cardholders in various states.
benefits: Cover up to ₹30,000 - ₹50,000 for family of five for common hospitalization charges.

ministry: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department, MP
description: Gives MP families access to highly subsidized grains (wheat, rice, salt, kerosene) via fair price shops.
benefits: Wheat at ₹1/kg, Rice at ₹1/kg, and Salt at ₹1/kg under the National Food Security Act in MP.
required_documents: Aadhaar Cards of all family members

ministry: State Health Agency, Government of Madhya Pradesh
description: State integrated program linking PM-JAY and State welfare boards to provide health cards to MP residents.
benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh/year in government and empaneled private hospitals for all MP Samagra BPL families.

ministry: Food and Civil Supplies Department, Uttar Pradesh
description: Provides subsidized ration (rice, wheat, sugar) to eligible families in Uttar Pradesh under Antyodaya and Patra Grihasti categories.
benefits: Wheat at ₹2/kg and Rice at ₹3/kg (and free grain distributions during special drives) at all UP government ration depots.
required_documents: Passport size photograph of Head of Family (Female preferred)
